visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Scene opens in an indoor studio or office environment. A young woman with dark wavy hair, wearing a white tank top and black pants, stands on the left. She is smiling and gesturing towards a man wearing a grey New Balance t-shirt who is sitting at a desk with a laptop. Behind them, shelves are stocked with various snacks and office supplies. (2) The woman lifts her arms to gather her hair into a ponytail. The man watches her attentively with his chin resting on his hand. Visual heart graphics and a pink haze overlay the screen. (3) A second woman wearing a black blazer over a white graphic tee enters from the right. She physically strikes the man on the back of his head. The man looks surprised and rubs his head while the second woman scolds him with a stern facial expression and crossed arms. (4) The man stands up and gestures towards the first woman, who is now laughing in the background. The man points his finger directly at the camera lens while the second woman watches him skeptically. (5) A full-screen graphic appears with a bright yellow background and large black Chinese characters. Small disclaimer text is visible at the bottom. (6) The three individuals are shown together. The man is in the foreground, speaking with high energy and using broad hand gestures. The two women stand behind him, smiling, nodding, and cheering. (7) A screen recording of an Instagram profile is shown. A red hand icon points to a specific highlight bubble on the profile page. (8) The group returns to the frame. They are all cheering and jumping. The man throws his arms out wide toward the camera, and the women clap and cheer enthusiastically behind him.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking in a friendly, conversational tone with moderate pitch. A male voice responds briefly. No background music is present, only a very clean room tone. (2) A transition occurs as a playful, romantic-style instrumental track with piano melodies and soft bell-like textures begins. The male voice continues to talk but with a more curious inflection. (3) A sharp, high-intensity 'slap' or impact sound effect triggers a sudden change. The music stops abruptly. (4) A second female voice enters, shouting with a high pitch and aggressive, scolding tone. Her speech is rapid and high-arousal. The male voice responds with a defensive, faster speech rate and lower volume. Faint background laughter from the first female is audible. (5) A bright digital 'ding' bell sound marks the transition to the informational phase. (6) An upbeat, high-tempo pop track with a strong electronic beat and synthesizer pads starts. A male voice speaks with high energy, clarity, and a professional narrative style, mimicking a recruitment pitch. (7) The video concludes with the three voices merging into a high-arousal cheer and shouting chorus, perfectly synchronized with the energetic climax of the background music.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous skit format to announce a job opening for an executive manager for the 'THE DODO MEN' team. By depicting a funny, relatable office conflict involving social media trends (the ponytail trend), the creators showcase their brand's personality before transitioning into a serious but energetic recruitment pitch and providing clear instructions on how to apply.
